description: AUROC comparison of bssentinel with traditional early warning scores. mNEWS2 = modified NEWS2 (without supplemental O2). qSOFA = quick SOFA (SBP ≤ 100, RR ≥ 22, GCS < 15). MEWS = Modified Early Warning Score. Shock Index = HR / SBP.

manuscript_changes.methods: Add computation of qSOFA, MEWS, and Shock Index from available features
manuscript_changes.table_3: Add rows for qSOFA, MEWS, Shock Index AUROCs
manuscript_changes.results_text: Report comparative AUROCs for all scores
manuscript_changes.NEWS2_labelling: Rename NEWS2 → mNEWS2 (modified NEWS2, excluding supplemental O2) throughout
